children: Evercore raised Apple (AAPL) price target to $380 from $365 after a 4,000-consumer survey showing strong iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max demand, potential unit growth and higher average selling prices.
AAPL launched iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max on Sept 18. New 2nm A20 Pro chip, greater AI, better cameras, longer battery. Prices start at $1,199 and $1,299, ~ $100 above prior Pro.
Apple (AAPL) will unveil its first foldable iPhone, the Duo, in about a month, adding a second premium hardware format to its iPhone lineup.
Survey: 53% of buyers plan iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max, Pro Max favored. Strong replacement demand and rising Apple Watch/AirPods interest. iPhone Duo may boost demand; valuation cited by respondents.
U.S. carriers raised maximum iPhone 18 Pro Max trade-in offers to $1,200 from $1,100 after a $100 Pro price hike; Bank of America keeps a Buy rating and $370 target on AAPL.
BofA's Wamsi Mohan keeps Buy on Apple (AAPL) with $370 target, citing multi‑year upgrade cycle, Siri AI and Duo AI upside, carrier trade‑in incentives up to $1,200 and rising ASPs.
Apple (AAPL) opened iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max preorders Sept. 12 with in-store availability a week later. Dealer lead times reported at 2–4 weeks, flat to slightly longer year‑over‑year.
About 1,600 Italian retail staff across 17 Apple stores struck on iPhone 18 Pro launch day, seeking more hires, permanent contracts and longer hours options; Apple said stores stayed open.
Morgan Stanley keeps Overweight on Apple (AAPL), citing AI-focused products, broad distribution and proprietary data as potential drivers for the stock.
Apple (AAPL) began retail sales for a new product across Delhi-NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru and Chennai with stores opening at 8 a.m.; customers queued hours early to buy devices.
